name: Deathly Familiar
body:
School necromancy [death, evil]; Level: cleric 3, sorcerer/wizard 3, witch 3

Casting Time: 1 standard action

Components: V, S, M (ground undead dust)

Range: Close (25 ft. + 5 ft./2 levels)

Target(s): One undead creature

Duration: 1 minute/2 levels (D) Saving Throw: None; Spell Resistance: yes

This spell temporarily turns an undead creature of 4 hit dice or less that is currently under your control (via the animate dead, control undead or command undead spells or the Command Undead feat) into your familiar. This works even if your class cannot normally have a familiar. Only one undead creature can be your familiar at a time. This spell has no effect if you already have a familiar of any kind.

For the duration of the spell, the undead familiar gains the following benefits:

If the undead creature’s intelligence is less than 6, its Intelligence increases to 6
+2 natural armor
Channel resistance +2
Alertness, share spells, deliver touch spells
Speak with master
You gain a +1 enhancement bonus on saves vs. paralyzation, death effects, stunning, and poison.
While the undead familiar is within arm’s reach, you also gain the Alertness feat.
